notes.title: 🏚️ Real Estate Simulator 2 - Build, Renovate, and Flip for Profit!
notes.content:
[p]REAL ESTATE 2 is a business simulator where you turn abandoned apartments into beautiful, profitable homes and build your career from scratch.
[/p][p]You’re in control of everything - from repairs and design to logistics. Buy a vehicle, load up furniture, and deliver it yourself to make each property perfect.
[/p][p]Every property is a unique challenge. It’s not just cosmetic fixes - you’ll remove trash, wipe off dirt with a sponge, and breathe new life into the homes. The day and night cycle adds realism - hold showings during the day, prepare apartments for sale at night.
[/p][p]The market is always changing: watch demand, adjust prices, and close profitable deals. In REAL ESTATE 2, success depends on your skills, patience, and strategy.

Ready to turn ruins into your empire? Start your real estate career today!

Missed the original? Discover the roots of your empire-building journey with the classic: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2738900/REAL_ESTATE_Simulator"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]
